name: Riding Dog
description: A bristly huge dog with sharp tusks and a saddle strapped tight.

name: Horse
description: A sturdy brown horse, steady on long roads and calm in the face of danger.

name: Warhorse
description: A massive armored warhorse bred for battle, unshaken by steel, fire or the roar of the crowd.

name: Centaur
description: A proud centaur who lets only the worthy ride, bow in hand and bound by an oath of loyalty.

name: Unicorn
description: A pure white unicorn whose spiraled horn glows with healing light.

name: Pegasus
description: A winged white horse that gallops across the clouds, swift as the wind itself.

name: Boar
description: A bristly giant boar with sharp tusks and a saddle strapped tight, stubborn and quick to charge.

name: Dire Wolf
description: A towering gray dire wolf with a thick ruff, fast on the hunt and fierce in battle.

name: Mammoth
description: A shaggy woolly mammoth with curling tusks, strong enough to carry a whole camp through the snow.

name: Griffin
description: A griffin with an eagle's head and a lion's body, carrying its rider high above the battlefield.

name: Roc
description: A colossal mythic bird whose wingbeats stir up storms, able to carry its rider across whole kingdoms.

name: Dragon
description: A mighty dragon of scale and flame, the rarest of mounts and a legend in its own right.

name: Terror Bird
description: A towering flightless bird with a hooked beak, fast across open plains and vicious in a fight.

name: Giant Scorpion
description: A sand-colored giant scorpion with a saddle between its claws, its stinger raised over its rider.

name: Giant Spider
description: A hairy cave spider that carries its rider along walls and ceilings where no horse could follow.

name: Manticore
description: A lion-bodied manticore with bat wings and a spiked tail, savage but loyal to a rider who tamed it.

name: Chimera
description: A three-headed chimera of lion, goat and serpent, breathing fire as it charges into battle.

name: Hydra
description: A many-headed hydra that regrows every severed head, an unstoppable mount for the boldest of riders.

name: Giant Turtle
description: A patient sea turtle with a barnacled shell, gliding calmly along coastlines and shallow reefs.

name: Hippocampus
description: A sea-horse with a horse's front and a fish's tail, galloping through the waves.

name: Giant Shark
description: A scarred giant shark fitted with a saddle harness, cutting through deep water at terrifying speed.

name: Kraken
description: A young kraken whose great tentacles pull its rider through the darkest ocean trenches.

name: Sea Serpent
description: A glittering sea serpent that coils through storms and dives beneath the heaviest waves.

name: Leviathan
description: An ancient leviathan of the abyss, vast as an island and older than the oldest kingdoms.
